newsitem.title: USA: IndeNet to exchange Series A preferred.
newsitem.headline: IndeNet to exchange Series A preferred.

text.p: Indenet Inc said on Friday that 76 percent of the holders of its Series A preferred stock agreed to exchange the shares for new Series C preferred.
The holders' shares represent $7.71 million of the $10.21 million outstanding Series A preferred, the company said.
The new Series C converts into common stock at a fixed price of $5 a share. The preferred stock is non-voting and bears an eight percent accretion rate.

After a six-month lock-up period, conversion into common stock is limited to 10 percent of Series C shares per month. At the time of exchange, the holders will also receive common stock purchase warrants with an exercise price of $5 per share. The number of warrants will equal 10 percent of the issue price of their Series C shares divided by $5.
Other conditions apply. In a statement, the company said the new issue "removes the uncertainty of the previously outstanding Series A" shares.
